Frequently asked questions

How many DevOps Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 22 open DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $163,125–$223,000 a year, based on 16 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include SYSTOLIC (12 listings), Military Spouse Corporate Career Network (2 listings), Advanced Systems Design (1 listing), Blueprint Technologies (1 listing), and Digital Hands (1 listing).

Do I need experience?

These listings match explicit entry-level, junior, graduate or early-career titles. A title alone does not confirm an experience requirement; review the original posting.
